<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin="par131" />{{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=30|verse=20}} parallel with {{GHGheb|text=לֶ֫חֶם צַר}}) ''water'' which is ''affliction'', drunk in trouble (imprisonment). Still more boldly, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=5|verse=3}} {{GHGheb|text=בָּקָר רְעִי|translate=oxen}} which were taken out of the ''pastures'', and {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=6|verse=7}} ''undressed stones'' which come from the ''quarry'', probably a corruption of {{GHGheb|text=מִמַּסָּע}}. A person and a condition are in apposition in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=18|verse=6}} (unless {{GHGheb|text=בְּנִדָּתָהּ}} is to be read).—In {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=4|verse=1}} read {{GHGheb|text=אֶ֫בֶן הָע׳}}, as in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=5|verse=1|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=7|verse=12|hidebook=1}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|131|d}}
(''c'') Collocation of the ''person'' ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=28|verse=36}}) or ''thing'' (form) and ''material'',<ref>Cf. also the examples treated above in {{GHGpar|127|h}}.</ref> or of the ''place'' or ''measure'' and its ''contents'', e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=15|verse=19}} {{GHGheb|text=נְה֫שֶׁת בִּמְצִלְתַּ֫יִם|translate=with cymbals}} which were ''brass'', i.e. of brass; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=26|verse=25}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=11|verse=8}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=28|verse=15}}, 18 (''?''); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=28|verse=17}} ''four rows'', namely ''stones'' (for which 39:10 has {{GHGheb|text=טוּרֵי אָ֑בֶן}}); cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=4|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=6|verse=3}} (see, however, {{GHGpar|128|d}}); {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=7|verse=1}} {{GHGheb|text=סְאָה סֹ֫לֶת|translate=a seah of fine flour}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=7|verse=6.18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=18|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=16|verse=33}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=5|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=2|verse=17}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=16|verse=24}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=5|verse=23}} {{GHGheb|text=כִּכְּרַ֫יִם כֶּ֫סֶף|translate=two talents}} of ''silver'';<ref>On the anomalous form {{GHGheb|text=כִּכְּרַ֫יִם}} (instead of {{GHGheb|text=כִּכָּרַ֫יִם}}; cf. {{GHGheb|text=כִּכָּרָ֑יִם}} immediately before), see {{GHGpar|88|b}}.</ref> cf. 5:17, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=39|verse=17}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=22|verse=18}} (if the text be right). With the ''material'' placed before the ''measure'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=30|verse=23}} f..—A ''period of time'' and its contents are placed in apposition {{GHGheb|text=חֹ֫דֶשׁ יָמִים|translate=a month of days}}, i.e. a month’s time=for a whole month, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=29|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=11|verse=20}}, 21, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=21|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=15|verse=13}}, and {{GHGheb|text=שְׁנָתַ֫יִם יָמִים}} ''two years’ time'', i.e. two full years, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=41|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=13|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=14|verse=28|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=28|verse=3.11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=10|verse=2 f.}}.

Finally, under this head may be included all the cases in which a numeral (regarded as a substantive) is followed by the object numbered in apposition, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=שְׁלשָׁה בָנִים|translate=trias}} sc. ''filii'', {{GHGpar|97|a}} and {{GHGpar|134|b}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|131|e}}
(''d'') Collocation of the ''thing'' and the ''measure'' or ''extent, number'', &c., e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=9|verse=20}} {{GHGheb|text=יָמִים מִסְפָּר|translate=days}}, (a small) ''number'', i.e. only a few days; {{GHGheb|text=כֶּ֫סֶף מִשְׁנֶה|translate=money, repetition}}, i.e. twice as much money, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=43|verse=12}} (unless {{GHGheb|text=כֶּ֫סֶף}} be constr. st.); {{GHGheb|text=מַ֫יִם בִּרְכָּ֑יִם|translate=water}} which was of the measure of the ''knees'', which reached to the knees, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=47|verse=4}} (also {{GHGheb|text=מֵי מָתְנָ֑יִם|translate=water that was to the loins}}, in the same verse). This likewise includes the cases in which a noun is followed in apposition by a numeral (see {{GHGpar|134|c}}) or an adverb, originally conceived as a substantive, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=2|verse=12}} {{GHGheb|text=אֲנָשִׁים מְעַט|translate=men, a few}}, i.e. some few men; {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=5|verse=9}} {{GHGheb|text=תְּבוּנָה הַרְבֵּה|translate=understanding, much-making}}, i.e. much understanding, unless {{GHGheb|text=הַרְבֵּה}} is to be taken as an adverb with {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּתֵּן}}, as in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=8|verse=8}} with {{GHGheb|text=לָקַה}}.<section end="par131" /><noinclude>
